rationale: The plan matches the reference on the core network method: signed WGCNA on a variance-stabilized matrix, power chosen at the lowest value reaching scale-free fit ~0.8 with the curve reported, dynamic tree cut on 1-TOM, eigengene-trait correlation with BH across modules, and kME-based hubs. It falls short on stating the minimum module size, the eigengene merge threshold, and a top-variable-gene subset (~5000) for the network, and it is inconsistent about whether WGCNA consumes the VST or the voom matrix. QC, filtering (filterByExpr with a stated rule), TMM normalization, an explicit ~condition design with control as reference, and a well-specified ORA (tested-gene universe, named collections with versions, 15-500 window, per-collection BH) are all present. The DE arm names BH at 0.05 but gives no fold-change shrinkage or treat-style threshold for the reported effect; the report section is thorough on versions, parameters, counts, and caveats.
